stories.headline: Z.ai confirms it built Ox Alpha model and will release its weights

sources.title: Surprise: Z.ai is the AI lab behind the mysterious Ox Alpha model

stories.what_happened: Z.ai announced that it is the lab behind the Ox Alpha model, an open AI model that has been topping benchmarks and leaderboards, and said the model’s weights will be released soon.
stories.why_it_matters: Releasing the weights will let developers and researchers access a high‑performing model, enabling experimentation, fine‑tuning, and integration into applications without needing to train from scratch.

stories.headline: Runable raises $21M to expand AI agents for building and growing businesses

sources.title: Runable hits $21M to bet AI agents can go from building businesses to growing them

stories.what_happened: Runable announced a $21 million funding round aimed at developing AI agents that can both create and scale businesses. In the past 90 days, the company reported that 60%–70% of its over 1 trillion token usage came from paying customers.
stories.why_it_matters: The new capital will allow Runable to accelerate its AI agent platform, reflecting strong commercial demand as indicated by high token consumption from paying users. This suggests growing market interest in autonomous AI tools for business operations.

stories.developer_impact: Developers will be able to obtain the Ox Alpha weights, integrate the model into their backend or AI pipelines, and fine‑tune it for specific tasks.
stories.headline: Z.ai announces Ox Alpha GLM-series model and plans to release its weights

sources.title: Z.ai confirms Ox Alpha is a new GLM-series model and will release its weights

stories.what_happened: Z.ai confirmed that Ox Alpha, a new model in the GLM series, has been developed and the company intends to make the model weights publicly available.
stories.why_it_matters: Releasing the weights allows developers and researchers to download and run the model without training it from scratch, potentially accelerating AI development and increasing competition in the field.

stories.developer_impact: Deploying the model requires inference frameworks that support Mixture‑of‑Experts routing and sparse activation (e.g., vLLM). Engineers may need to provision larger GPU memory for the expert pool and adjust serving pipelines to handle token‑wise expert selection.
stories.headline: Giga-Embeddings introduce a 10 B‑parameter Mixture‑of‑Experts encoder with 1.8 B active parameters per token

sources.title: Giga-Embeddings: Mixture-of-Experts Encoders for High-Throughput Text Embeddings

stories.what_happened: The paper presents Giga-Embeddings, a family of text‑embedding models that combine strong retrieval quality with efficient serving. Its largest model is a sparse 10 billion‑parameter Mixture‑of‑Experts encoder that activates about 1.8 billion parameters per token. The model achieves the best aggregate scores among the family on English, Russian, multilingual, and code MTEB benchmarks and shows high throughput in vLLM benchmarks.
stories.why_it_matters: Higher‑throughput, high‑quality embeddings can improve large‑scale retrieval and similarity‑search systems while keeping latency low, enabling more responsive AI services and reducing compute cost per query.
